articles.title: My Campus Life
articles.text: My name is Li Hua, and I am a freshman at a university in Shanghai. I live in a dormitory with three roommates. Every morning, I get up at seven and go to the library to study. In the afternoon, I have classes and sometimes play basketball with my friends. In the evening, I usually review my notes and read English books. I enjoy my campus life very much because I have made many good friends here.

articles.title: A Day in the Park
articles.text: Last Sunday, my family and I went to the city park. The weather was sunny and warm. We took a picnic with us and sat under a big tree. My little sister played with a ball, and my parents talked with their friends. I walked around the park and took many photos of the flowers. At noon, we had lunch together. Everyone was happy, and we all agreed to visit the park again next month.

articles.title: The Weather in Beijing
articles.text: The weather in Beijing changes a lot during the year. Spring is warm but sometimes windy. Summer is very hot, and it often rains in July and August. Autumn is the best season, with clear skies and cool air. Winter is cold and dry, but it is beautiful when it snows. Many people enjoy taking photos of the city in winter. When you visit Beijing, remember to check the weather before you go out.

articles.title: Reading on the Train
articles.text: Every day, thousands of people take the subway to work in big cities. Many of them read books or newspapers during the ride. Some people say that the subway is a good place to read because the ride gives them free time. A survey shows that people who read on the subway read about five more books a year than those who do not. Reading on the train is a small habit, but it can make a big difference in the long run.

articles.title: Robots at Home
articles.text: Robots are becoming more and more common in our daily lives. Today, some families use robot vacuum cleaners to clean their floors. In the future, robots may cook meals, wash dishes, and even take care of old people. Scientists say that robots can save us a lot of time, but they also remind us that robots cannot replace human feelings. We should use robots to help us, not to depend on them completely.

articles.title: The Mid-Autumn Festival
articles.text: The Mid-Autumn Festival is one of the most important traditional festivals in China. It falls on the 15th day of the eighth lunar month, when the moon is full and bright. On this day, family members get together, enjoy a big dinner, and eat mooncakes. People also watch the moon and tell stories about Chang'e, the goddess of the moon. For Chinese people, the festival means family reunion and happiness.

articles.title: Saving Water
articles.text: Water is one of the most valuable resources on the earth, but fresh water is getting less and less. Many people waste water every day without thinking about it. For example, some people keep the tap running while brushing their teeth. We can save water in simple ways: turn off the tap when we do not need it, take shorter showers, and reuse water for plants. If everyone saves a little water, we can protect our planet for the future.

articles.title: A Healthy Lifestyle
articles.text: A healthy lifestyle is important for everyone. Doctors suggest that we exercise for at least thirty minutes every day. Walking, running and swimming are all good choices. Eating more vegetables and less fast food is also important. Besides, we should sleep for about eight hours a night and stay away from smoking. If we follow these simple rules, we can keep our body and mind healthy and full of energy.

articles.title: Online Shopping
articles.text: Online shopping has changed the way people buy things. With just a few clicks, we can buy almost anything, from daily goods to electronic devices, and have them delivered to our door within days. The convenience of online shopping has made it popular, especially among young people. However, it also brings problems, such as buying things we do not really need and the risk of receiving poor-quality goods. Experts suggest that we compare prices and read reviews carefully before paying.

articles.title: The Importance of Teamwork
articles.text: Teamwork plays an important role in both school and work. When people work together, they can share ideas, learn from each other, and finish tasks faster. A famous saying goes, "Many hands make light work." However, teamwork is not always easy. Different opinions may cause arguments, and some members may do less than others. To make a team successful, everyone should communicate honestly, respect each other, and be willing to take responsibility.
